app_metadata.name: QuyHoạch AI (Urban Planning & Construction Order Management)

theme.description: Authority, clarity, and function-first. Clean Stark White base with Signal Red and Architectural Blue. Minimal gradients, high-contrast borders.

guidelines: No Inter or standard fonts for headings.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase with wide spacing.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with Swiss Brutalist tension. Use dense spacing (Control Room Grid) for Admin Dashboard, but generous spacing (p-6, p-8) for Citizen facing forms.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] relative bg-background_base flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: grid-cols-1 or grid-cols-2 (for quick action buttons on mobile)
surfaces: Glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 for sticky bottom navigation and headers.
Cards: Flat surfaces, 1px solid border (#E2E8F0 or #09090B for emphasis), 0px border-radius (sharp) or max 4px.

bottom_navigation.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full max-w-md bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border_subtle z-50

map_slider_comparison.description: Swipeable vertical divider to compare Satellite vs Planning maps.
map_slider_comparison.ui_structure: Relative container taking full available height. Two absolute image/map layers. The top layer has a clip-path driven by the slider position.
map_slider_comparison.slider_handle: 44x44px minimum touch target, white circle with shadow and two vertical arrows, centered on a 2px vertical white line.
map_slider_comparison.ai_anomalies: Overlay SVG polygons with pulsing animation (accent_alert) to highlight construction violations.

action_cards.style: bg-white border border-border_subtle p-5 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform
action_cards.typography: h3 for title, caption for description. Left aligned.
action_cards.icon_treatment: 24x24px icon in top left, colored primary.

citizen_home.name: Trang chủ (Home)
layout: Header: Greeting (Xin chào, Nguyễn Văn A) with a clean Swiss typography.
Hero Feature: 'So sánh quy hoạch' (Map Compare) - A large 16:9 card showing a preview of the map slider. Click to expand full screen.
Grid Actions: 2-column grid for 'Báo cáo vi phạm' (Report Violation) and 'Văn bản pháp luật' (Legal Docs).
Recent Updates List: Vertical stack of recent neighborhood planning news.

map_compare_full.name: So sánh AI (Map Compare)
layout: Full screen map view (excluding bottom nav).
Floating bottom-right button: 'Phân tích AI' (AI Analyze) which reveals pulsing red zones where actual construction doesn't match zoning.

report_violation.name: Báo cáo vi phạm (Report)
layout: Scrollable form with generous p-6 padding.
Photo Upload Area: Large dashed border rectangle (h-40) with Camera icon.
Location Auto-fetch: Read-only input styled like a technical readout (e.g. 'Tọa độ: 10.7626° N, 106.6602° E').
Submit CTA: Full width, solid primary background, bold white text.

admin_dashboard.name: Quản lý báo cáo (Admin View)
layout: Control Room Grid style: Dense, highly scannable.
Stats row: Tổng số (Total), Cần xử lý (Pending), Đã duyệt (Approved).
Report List: Cards with thumbnail, timestamp, address, and Status Badge.
Filter Chips: Horizontal scrollable row for filtering by status or violation type.

interactive_rules: All buttons must have a clear hover and active (press) state.
Map slider must support touch events (onTouchMove/onTouchStart).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, tabs, and form inputs (e.g. 'data-testid="report-submit-button"').
